## (0) Initialization Code

*(This code cell is set to auto-run upon page load!)*

```{webr}
#| label: init-sfdep
#| autorun: true
# library(tidyverse) loads *all* tidyverse libraries. For
# efficiency, here we just load the two we need (dplyr for
# the filter() function, and then ggplot2 for plotting)
library(dplyr) |> suppressPackageStartupMessages()
library(ggplot2) |> suppressPackageStartupMessages()
# For outputting interactive maps of sf objects
library(mapview) |> suppressPackageStartupMessages()
# Fix "API Key Required" message in mapview default basemap
mapviewOptions(basemaps = c("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas","Stadia.AlidadeSmoothDark","OpenStreetMap", "Esri.WorldImagery", "OpenTopoMap"))
# For downloading 
library(rnaturalearth) |> suppressPackageStartupMessages()
library(rnaturalearthdata) |> suppressPackageStartupMessages()
library(spdep) |> suppressPackageStartupMessages()
# For customization of tables
library(reactable) |> suppressPackageStartupMessages()
render <- function(df_obj) {
  return(reactable::reactable(
    df_obj,
    striped = TRUE,
    compact = TRUE,
    columns = list(
      nb_weight = reactable::colDef(
        format = reactable::colFormat(digits = 3)
      )
    )
  ))
}
```

* [Relevant Moraga](https://www.paulamoraga.com/book-spatial/spatial-neighborhood-matrices.html)
* [Relevant Pebesma](https://r-spatial.org/book/14-Areal.html#contiguous-neighbours)

## (1) Finding Neighbors in Asia

### (1.1) Download Countries as `POLYGON`s from `rnaturalearth`

Here we use `rnaturalearth::ne_countres()`, with the `continent` option. We specify `scale=50` since otherwise smaller countries like Bahrain get excluded!

```{webr}
#| label: get-asia-polys
asia_countries_sf <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(
  continent = "Asia", scale=50
)
mapview(asia_countries_sf, label="geounit")
```

### (1.2) Detecting Neighbors with `spdep::poly2nb()`

Given an `sf` object, `spdep::poly2nb()` identifies **all pairs** of touching `POLYGON`s.



```{webr}
#| label: compute-neighbors
library(spdep)
asia_countries_nb <- asia_countries_sf |>
  spdep::poly2nb(
    queen = TRUE,
    row.names=asia_countries_sf$geounit
  )
asia_countries_nb
```

```{webr}
#| label: plot-centroids
nb_cents <- sf::st_point_on_surface(asia_countries_sf) |>
  sf::st_as_sf()
mapview(nb_cents, label="geounit")
```

```{webr}
#| label: plot-neighbors
nb_lines <- spdep::nb2lines(
  asia_countries_nb,
  coords=st_coordinates(nb_cents),
  as_sf=TRUE
)
nb_lines$edgelabel <- paste0(nb_lines$i_ID, "-", nb_lines$j_ID)
mapview(nb_cents, label="geounit") + mapview(nb_lines, label="edgelabel")
```

```{webr}
#| label: print-nb-object
print(asia_countries_nb)
```

## (2) Zooming In: Afghanistan and its Neighborhood

```{webr}
#| label: ggplot-afg-neighbors
library(ggplot2)
asia_nb_names <- attributes(asia_countries_nb)$region.id
afg_index <- which(asia_nb_names == "Afghanistan")
asia_countries_sf$neighbors <- "other"
asia_countries_sf$neighbors[afg_index] <- "area"
asia_countries_sf$neighbors[asia_countries_nb[[afg_index]]] <- "neighbors"
afg_sf <- asia_countries_sf |>
  dplyr::filter(neighbors != "other")
ggplot(afg_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = neighbors)) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("gray30", "gray", "white")
  )
```

```{webr}
#| label: mapview-afg-neighbors
mapview(afg_sf, zcol="neighbors", label="geounit")
```

```{webr}
#| label: nb-weights
nb_weights <- asia_countries_nb |>
  spdep::nb2listw(zero.policy=TRUE)
nb_weights
```

```{webr}
#| label: afg-tibble
afg_df <- tibble(
  nb_name=asia_countries_sf$geounit[nb_weights$neighbours[[afg_index]]],
  nb_index=nb_weights$neighbours[[afg_index]],
  nb_weight=nb_weights$weights[[afg_index]]
)
render(afg_df)
```

## (3) Computing Neighborliness *Weights*

```{webr}
#| label: distance-weights
nb_dist_weights <- asia_countries_nb |>
  spdep::nb2listwdist(nb_cents, zero.policy=TRUE)
nb_dist_weights
```

```{webr}
#| label: afg-distance-weights
afg_dist_df <- tibble(
  nb_name=asia_countries_sf$geounit[nb_dist_weights$neighbours[[afg_index]]],
  nb_index=nb_dist_weights$neighbours[[afg_index]],
  nb_weight=nb_dist_weights$weights[[afg_index]]
)
render(afg_dist_df)
```
